summary: Computer Science student specializing in Applied Artificial Intelligence with hands‑on experience in Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) and Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG). Experienced in building end‑to‑end AI pipelines, from data preprocessing to system deployment.

education.institution: Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology, VNUHCM

projects.name: End-to-End ASR & Speech Translation Pipeline
projects.description: Automated ASR pipeline using WhisperX with timestamp alignment and optional speaker diarization; fine‑tuned Whisper model for Vietnamese‑English speech translation; Vietnamese spelling correction via Gemini API; modular CLI architecture for audio normalization, batch inference, and subtitle generation.

projects.name: University Regulation Question-Answering System (RAG)
projects.description: Domain‑specific RAG system for university regulation Q&A; markdown‑aware recursive document chunking; hybrid retrieval combining dense vector search (Chroma) and BM25 ranking; LLM‑based query analysis, contextual response generation, and conversational memory for multi‑turn dialogue.
